name: 4.0.~ Bullets USEC ISB X Borkel's Realistic Night Vision support
teaser: While no longer needed for 4.1.2, This addon will add support for Sam C-137's ISB PVS-31As and GPNVGS to Borkel's Realistic Night Vision Goggles.
description_html:
While this is no longer necessary for those playing on more up to date versions of the BRNVG mod as it has been integrated, for those on older, pre 4.1.2 versions, this addon will still work and be kept around.

Simply put, This addon will add support for Sam C-137’s ISB PVS-31As and GPNVGS to Borkel’s Realistic Night Vision Goggles.

If there are any issues please mention them to me. It’s simple enough that I believe it won’t break with the only potential issue is an update to Aishi changing the item ID for the nods.
